description: This file declares and implements functions for computing 32-bit CRC checksums, primarily defining a CRC32 table, inline functions to calculate CRC from buffers, and the associated interface.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32(uint32_t val,const void * ss,int len)
methods.description: Computes CRC32 checksum for a buffer using a provided initial value.

methods.name: unsigned int crc32buf(char * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for a buffer starting with initial value 0xFFFFFFFF.
